description: Upgrade a Kubernetes cluster (EKS, GKE, AKS, or kubeadm) by exactly one minor version. Enforces +1 minor version constraint and scans for removed API violations before the irreversible control-plane step. Node pools are upgraded in a rolling fashion and can be rolled back to their previous image.

target_version.label: Target Version
target_version.description: Target Kubernetes minor version (e.g. 1.29). Must be exactly one minor version ahead of current.

cluster_type.label: Cluster Type
cluster_type.description: eks | gke | aks | kubeadm | auto (default: auto-detected)

drain_timeout_seconds.label: Drain Timeout (s)
drain_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for a node to drain before failing (default: 300)

max_unavailable.label: Max Unavailable Nodes
max_unavailable.description: Maximum nodes that can be unavailable at once during rolling upgrade (default: 1)

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run preflight checks only — no changes applied

rollback.description: Node pools are restored to previous image (FILO order). Control plane upgrade is irreversible — Kubernetes does not support downgrade of the control plane.

steps.description: Validate version path, scan for removed API violations, check node resource headroom
Upgrade the Kubernetes control plane — IRREVERSIBLE
Rolling node pool upgrade with drain/cordon and PDB respect
